CommunityApplications.Profile: 由 baofeidyz 维护的 Unraid Community Applications 模板。本仓库提供带内置 PostgreSQL 数据库的 MT Photos，以及智能识别 API 和 InsightFace 人脸识别 API 模板。模板支持：https://github.com/baofeidyz/unraid-template-mtphotos/issues English: Unraid Community Applications templates maintained by baofeidyz. This repository provides MT Photos with bundled PostgreSQL, its AI recognition API and an InsightFace facial recognition API. For template support, use https://github.com/baofeidyz/unraid-template-mtphotos/issues
